title: On $S$-Noetherian Lattices
summary: In this paper, we define and study $S$-Noetherian lattices as a natural generalization of Noetherian rings. We prove that a ring $R$ is $S$-Noetherian if and only if its ideal lattice, $Id(R)$, is $S_L$-Noetherian. Furthermore, we establish a Cohen-Kaplansky type theorem for $S$-Noetherian lattices, showing that $L$ is $S$-Noetherian if and only if every $S$-prime element of $L$ is $S$-compact.
